text: Works great, but I do appreciate the paper discs.
Almost as easy and cheaper than the paper. Works as promised.
Works perfectly and so nice not to have to keep a lot of paper filters on hand. I am doing a lot of camping so this is perfect! I'll continue to use this!
Unlike paper filter, the coffee retains more oil and more flavor.

Decent product. To be fair I really don't taste any difference supposedly provided by "not absorbing the coffee oils" but it does what it is supposed to do.
This being said, the paper filters were much easier to clean since you basically just dump them.
I am using the filter daily and it is easy to use, clean and I don't have to worry about running out or re-ordering paper filters.
Works great - nice to have something reusable.

I have another metal filter that uses a very fine metal mesh and it works much better than this filter. I like to use an espresso grind when making coffee with my AeroPress, because it seems to take less coffee to create the same results as a less finely ground (drip) bean. When I use the espresso grind with this filter, it is difficult to press the plunger down (nearly impossible, even when taking longer than a minute to compress) when compared to the metal mesh or paper filters I have used. Theoretically I like the design of this filter, but in reality it doesn't work well for me.
Terrific. Woks well, cleans easily
Great product.  This makes the arrived espresso press even more compact and easier to clean.  Nice add on when ordering the arrived.
very good
WHAT A GREAT IDEA.  FANTASTIC COFFEE WITHOUT MESSING WITH PAPER FILTERS.

I have read MANY reviews and bought the AeroPress system and this was recommended by many.  Works like a charm and I don't have to worry about getting rid of soggy paper filters and replacing them.  I go out to my gardens, give the Aeropress a good strong push and out pops the used grounds right into my flower beds like a hockey puck.  Win-win
I don't like the taste of paper so I got this.  Works perfectly however it came scratched.
drips faster than paper making coffee weaker, the opposite of the point of aeropressing.  great if you use the upside down brew method.
Maybe He-Man can push down the press with one of these things in but not me.
This is a great filter. Easy to clean, and I can't taste any difference between using this and the paper filters that come with the AeroPress.
Great filter. I'm all about reusable. See my review on the AeroPress coffee maker.

I am very satisfied with this filter. I wanted a filter I could reuse for my aeropress, but most of the ones I saw online were made with a flimsy metal ring and wire mesh and didn't seem to hold up long-term. This one is very solid because it is made from one piece of metal, and using it did not change the flavor of my coffee in any noticeable way, which surprised me. This is truly a great buy if you are looking for a sturdy reusable filter for your aeropress.

I bought this filter for my AeroPress coffee maker. It fits well, but I found that it didn't work as well as the paper filters for finely ground coffee.  There was a lot of sediment at the bottom of my coffee, which maybe some people would enjoy, but I don't prefer it.  It's still a great backup if I ever run out of paper filters. It is easy to clean, and still looks shiny and new.
Much better than paper filters!

This solved one of my problems that I had with the aero press which was with the paper filters being very difficult to press thru. Not quite as tidy in clean up as the paper filters.

High quality stainless steel, zero rust.
Use it every day and it works like a charm. I'll never go back to paper filters again.
Great product, really like not having to use the paper filters. I've been using one for about six months now with no issues
This works so much better than the paper filters, and I love that I can just rinse it off and reuse it.
Works as intended, resuable, clean finish and does not really let many, if any, grinds through my Aeropress
Works great and I like not having to deal with the paper filters.
works great, allows the oils of the coffee to come through for a richer flavor

This is a much better alternative to paper filters. It is more environmentally friendly and allows more of the oils to make it into your cup. Using a good quality grinder, there was very little sediment in the cup compared to other mesh filters I have used in the past.
Works as advertised.
Works great.
Works like a charm, I love it!
Love it.  Arrived promptly and works as indicated.

Nice and convenient. I believe this is slightly less porous than the original paper filter. In my book that's a good thing and allows for slightly stronger cups of coffee when the original paper filters left the coffee slightly weak.

I did have to change my "cleanup" workflow to first tilt the aeropress upside down, remove the cap, slide off the filter, and then dump. The first time I accidentally pushed out the "puck" with the filter into the trash. So, just remember NOT to do what I did.
Awesome product! I wish that I had purchased sooner.  Works just like the paper filters.
Arrived earlier than expected and works perfectly!
Absolutely fantastic. Good material, perfect fit. This is a must for Aeropress owners!
Great for on the go lifestyles. Fits in a neat little bag and is light weight. I use it almost everyday.
This was a great purchase to go with my Aero Press. No need to even opened the paper filters that came with because I use this every time.
Regular filters absorb the natural oils of the coffee bean. The stainless allows them to pass and gives you the best possible extraction from your coffee. Cleans easily.
In my opinion, slightly better than mesh filters. On balance, comparable to paper filters.

Great filter for my AeroPress coffee maker!  I use this instead of the paper filters and it makes a great cup of coffee.  I don't notice any grit or residual grind in the bottom of my cup and I do not notice a difference in the pressure needed to make a cup with the AeroPress.  You don't need to use the inverted method when brewing in your AeroPress, it works just fine in the standard configuration - once the coffee is on top of the filter you can add water with minimal drip going into the cup before the plunger is in place.
Immediately noticed an improved body & mouthfeel of my coffee after switching from paper filters, which absorb some of the coffee oils.
I like these mesh filters, although the paper filters work well, and I routinely use them 4-5 times before I discard them. This one is course, compare to The MESH which is very fine.
Works perfectly, and the coffee taste is noticeably better compared with paper filters.
product as described

This filter seems to be close to the paper filter in terms of how easy it is for push the plunger. I'd rate it as slightly more difficult, but not by a huge margin.The coffee has some fine particles at the bottom with this filter vs. a paper filter. That didn't bother me, but it might bother others.

The coffee tastes good to me, but cleanup is more difficult. I can't really blame Altura for the difficult cleanup — their product is exactly what I wanted because I wanted the coffee oils.
Fits perfectly rinses out easy does allow brew to trickle through while stirring screw the paper filters

It gets five stars because it does exactly what it says it does. Easy enough to clean, does not interfere with tightening the bottom of the chamber.  The flavor is much more full than what I get from using a paper filter. My morning coffee has gone from good to really good.
Very fine mesh, that is easy to clean  :)
The product works as described and I have no complaints. I like the paper filters and plan to this filter as backup should I run out. It's a fine product.

I was concerned that the metal filter would allow for grounds to find their way into the coffee, but I was happy to discover that the filter uses a very fine mesh pattern on front, with even smaller holes on the back in order to prevent anything but coffee from getting into your cup. On occasion you will find a few grounds, but it's far less that I used to have in my French press. After a month of use, the filter is still perfect, and cleaning is a cinch (just run under the faucet). Would highly recommend this over the standard
This works great. We use it every day and it beats having to buy replacement paper filters. I think it helps get more oil extracted from the beans to to the coffee, too, which paper would absorb.

I do like this idea, but this exact model let a little too much sediment through to the cup for me. Not enough that I stopped using it, or would ever complain about it. However, the seller reached out to see if I was happy and I relayed this info - without hesitation, he recommended the Ultra-mesh model, and asked to verify my address and shipped it to me right away! Talk about great customer service!! The ultra-mesh is perfect for my style, the cup is so delicious, and no sediment at all!

Highly recommend the product, just find the one that fits your needs best - and couldn't recommend the seller any higher!

I've had my Aeropress for 2+ years now and used primarily paper filters and once tried a sad and cheap mesh net filter, but this changes everything. This is an incredibly well manufactured product. I didn't think that I'd be able to press a better cup, but this filter lets the true flavor of your grounds shine. I'd recommend this product to any Aeropress owner or user.
Too fine of a filter, went back to paper

Works well in filtering the grounds.  Easily cleaned.  I have never used the paper filters included with the Aeropress, so I can't compare them.  But I'm very satisfied with the coffee I'm making now.  Why change.
Great
love it
Arrived earlier than expected, does not bend or warp, and easy to clean.  Adds a good kick to 'Aeropress'ed coffee.
It flows pretty fast, and a bit of sludge makes it into the cup. Beats discovering that the paper filter has slipped though.
Good, do its job
Much better flavor than the paper filters that remove too much of the essential oils. I'm quite pleased with this purchase.
Fits my Keurig K40 Elite perfectly.
I had to adjust the rubber stopper inside the keurig surrounding the needle so the water didn't spew out, but once I did that these worked great!
Disapointed in the quality of these, The hinges are just creased plastic instead of an actual hinge and look like they are going to break any minute and the screens are already warped.
I own a Keurig 2.0 with carafe...The Keurig would not function using the reusable filter.
they create a mess

I hate giving three star reviews because these do "work" like a Keurig cup. The problem (which I didnt consider but you should before buying) is that most coffee that you grind yourself would be "drip" coffee to get the full taste of the coffee. Keurig pretty much just shoots water through the cup. So no matter what grind level you do with your beans you get a weak, watery cup of coffee. I dont know what is inside a K-Cup but it isnt simple ground coffee. So the cups work as advertised, but the cup of coffee you get isnt worth it. Good seller, good shipping. Just doesn't create a decent cup of coffee.

I spend a lot of money on my Keurig each month. Grocery shopping bills mount up when I am spending an extra $20-$40 on each grocery bill because I need the $10 coffee or $15 chai tea blend. These are not only great on my wallet, but they also help with the environment. For every Keurig pod disposed in the trash, I feel that it adds to environmental waste, and we really do not need that. I wish they would come up with eco cups or something that is easily disposed of and also good for the environment, but until they figure that out I will be using my reusable cups. I know that they aren't as convenient or easy as the disposable cups, but every morning I have my coffee and every morning I make sure that I have my K-Cup ready the night before so I don't run into any hitches the next day and now that I am able to section off how much coffee I want in each K-Cup, I am able to save more coffee and it really has been working great for my budget! I also like these because I can buy any type of tea or coffee and it doesn't have to be limited to just K-Cups! I received a discount on this product in a special promotion. My review, my opinion and experience is honest and 100% genuine and if anyone would like to message me about it- I am open to answering questions as open and honestly as I can! I chose to purchase this item based on the quality and positive reviews and I wanted to share how I felt with you.
work great on my K45...  hope they last
These are perfect for using your own coffee in your keurig
great alternative to disposable k cups!  i find that coffee tasts great from these and i do less and less k - cups nowadays.  great purchase!
Great for the price!
2 were broken,,will not order again
Solid product, works well, cleans pretty easily.

These work fairly well esp for the price. I did 4 stars because they don't always stay closed and I notice a lot more "sludge" and grounds at the bottom of my cup with these than previous ones I have tried.

This was a great purchase (actually thinking on buying more).  I've been using them for about a month, and I drink a lot of coffee... and so far I haven't had any issues.  Maybe my only complain is not knowing exactly how much should I fill them, because I initially added too much coffee.
Didn't fit my Kuerig

I love these reusable K-cups. I got tired of spending so much money on the boxes of k-cups so I decided to get reusable ones. Easy to use, they are a little difficult to clean though. I recommend letting it dry out completely and then shaking them out. The majority of the coffee will come out then. Ran these through my dishwasher and they did perfectly fine as well.

I have used several different 'styles' of reusable pods and these are by far the worst.  I thought that since it had a bigger meshed surface area, it would give me a stronger coffee flavor.  It did just the opposite.  The water just pours through and makes for a very weak and watered down coffee.  Don't waste your money on these!
Has to have a paper filter to keep the grounds out of your coffee. Its the only thing I have ever gotten that am unhappy with. Wish I could send back and get my cash back.

I was going to stop using my kurig because I didn't like the fact that all those little coffee cups that you insert into the machine are not recyclable. Then I found these on Amazon and now have can really enjoy my coffee more knowing I am not putting all those cups in the dump
Went to use the first one & the whole thing bent just trying to close it.  I need to find the other ones I bought before that were way better & cheaper!  So disappointed in these!
great product
Good price for a six pack and they work quite well but they need the little sticker on the lid to make them work on my K550 2.0, otherwise 5 stars buddy. I'll buy more of course.
Fits my keurig 1.0 just fine where some other cups that claim to fit some 1.0 do not.
The reusable filters are great. Now we can buy coffee and make our own coffee with our Keurig, and save a few pennies. Great job
ok

So far (1 month of use), these have been working well. They are durable enough, but I am careful because the lid is just held together by plastic, no pin hinge to keep it on. Water seems to accumulate on the top after use, but that is no big deal. The sealer got these to my house extremely fast. Overall very happy!
Great filters and they really cut down on the waste. Coffee tastes great
Works out perfectly
Works well with regular ground coffee, but with espresso type it may have a tendency to be slow.
Awesome product great price and fast shipping

Works' great. Just what I needed.

A+

Have a Keurig in both homes. These refillable pods have literally saved me thousands over the years. Please understand I'm serious about the savings. Many people are just too lazy to refill these cups, but I got tired of buying the pods 7 years ago and have refilled them with good dark roast coffee of our choice for less than $0.20 a cup.

The product does not fit the Keurig K140 model, although the description states otherwise. I even removed the injector pod and closed the cover, but water spilled everywhere. Thankfully Amazon refunded my order.

I received my order on day expected and love
The pods
I love them. What I expected and more!
They are what they are.  They fit.  Used them 4-5 times and they haven't fallen apart.

We only used it twice so far.  Worked great with ground coffee - didn't leak grounds into the cup.  Second time we tried it with fresh beans and found you definitely need the right grind.  The first time, we ground them too coarse and the coffee was too weak but that is user error and not the fault of the filter.  I was going to buy the paper inserts for these to make it easier to clean but if you dump the grounds right away and rinse the filter it is no trouble at all.
These little things area GREAT!!

One was apparently crushed in shipping.  Aside from that, they're cheap imitations.  Flimsy thin plastic.  They leak inside the head of the Keurig and make a mess.  I returned them.  Pay the price and get the rear thing.
Leaks if you fill the cup FULL.  And you need to fill it full to get the coffee strong enough.
These work very, very well.  Much better than the one I got a Walmart.  Lots more mesh area and the lid closes with a solid click.

These are exactly what I wanted, lots of mesh so the coffee is rich and easy to clean.  I had 3 similar to these from Kohls and have had them for years.  Even with the broken lid on one of the old ones, they are still useful.  I may order more as it is nice when I have company.
Work great with my Keurig

These reusable cups work great. This is the second time I have ordered them (my mom liked them so much she took my first set). They hold up nice. They fit into my Keurig perfectly.

Update 2/11/17
They are still working great, My only issue is the center piece of the lid pops out on a few of them, and I have lost the small piece in the garbage. Other then that they still do what they are supposed to and I have just made the one missing its center piece for tea instead of coffee.

I like to have a cup of decaf coffee in the late evening but decaf coffee pods can be very hard to find. Using the reusable filter cups and packaged coffee is a perfect answer for my Keurig mini one cup coffee maker. My only concern was keeping the top down on the pod after filling it.  Apparently it stays down while the coffee maker is brewing because there are no grains of coffee in my cup. The Solo Filter Pods from iPartsPlusMore work out fine for me.
WOrk great!!  Do not need to buy expensive ones.
Thesw are far better than the ones I have tried before, the lid is super tight, you have to apply good force to open or close them. Have been using them for over a month, good so far...
Works well with my Keurig
Saves a fortune

These reusable pods work great.  Turn them upside down under running water and tap the pod with your hand or lightly against the side of the sink and most of the grinds will come right out.  The savings from being able to use bags or canisters of coffee will pay for the pods very quickly.
as promised
This is my second order of reusable Keurig solo cups.  They are affordable, work as advertised and an excellent way to reduce packaging produces in landfills.
works really great and easy to clean-  wouldn't be without, especially nice if you grind your own beans.
We lost 2 of the o rings on the top before we realized that they came off. We have to be very careful with the other 4 as they come off too easily. I will not recommend that anyone buy them.
Good value. I can reuse the same cup over and over and over, Even though they came several to a package I don't need to.
Our keruig uses only the kcups with Keruig Hot logo. The screen indicated these kcups were not compatible with our unit, therefore wouldn't produce our coffee/tea.

These refillable pods do NOT work with the Keirig K200 model, although that model is listed with the compatible models of coffee makers. We've opened the package and tried one out. It's a no-go. Disappointed, and will be returning pods for a refund.
Good products at a great price. No problem at all & fits perfectly in our Keurig.
the receipt of these pods was much faster than I thought....I love them but, just have to learn how tightly to pack them with coffee to get the perfect brew of coffee in my cup
These arrived on time and were just as I expected them to be.  They are ingenious, very handy and great to have when the pods run out. Thank you!
Fit perfectly and easy to rinse and reuse

I love these little cups. I use the paper liners in them and if you don't pack too much coffee in them, they won't burst open at the bottom. Even so, you don't get a bunch of grounds in your coffee. Funny, the coffee manufacturers say use 2 tb per cup which I am assuming is 8 oz. But the coffee makers make their basket/cups to a capacity of 1 tb. How come they can't get together?
Still, these are the best filter pods because there is more mesh exposed than some of the other pods. That's more coffee being brewed with a larger side of mesh than the others.

The best part is that you can buy different blends of coffee and mix them to suit your taste. You don't get that with commercial pods and these cost far less per cup than commercial. If you read up on it, most of the commercial pods are the cheaper grade of coffee.
Perfect for using my own coffee. Can use the exact amount that I prefer.

I had bought the original basket gray color Refill original from keurig  and had been using that for the past six months and every time I used it I was like why was this not strong coffee  so I decided to stop refilling and just buy the Kurig pre-field which were expensive then a friend of mine told me to get these and I got them yesterday and I bought ground coffee the same one that I always use and I tried it and this is my 3rd cup of coffee today and it all turned out  excellent the taste is the same as the pre-filled ones that you buy from the store and a lot of coffee can go into a little pod so it's up to you if you want a lot of little depending on your taste buds Plus I did not have to take out the black basket from the Kahrig machine I just put these pods in and that's it ready to go
Works perfectly in my 525 Keurig. Great way to use your own special coffee.
A terrific K cup substitute. It really works

work well, caps attached, have some with detachable caps that I prefer, but do the job.

These are a great money saving alternative to prepackaged kcups. You brew your favorite coffee for a fraction of the cost. If you're a tree hugger there's no plastic to dispose.

I was unsure about getting these.. I did and I am so glad. They work really well and are easy to use and to clean.

These are a sustainable solution to the K-cup.  Easy to use and clean out.  For $10, a very good value.  I like these much better than the ONE I purchased direct from Keurig.  Liked them so much, I ordered another set for my work Keurig.
